bio: Queens of Mayfair is a relaxed luxury setting in the heart of one of London’s most exclusive areas, which is now serving a delicious Afternoon Tea.  With a focus on British cuisine using artisan and organic ingredients, their Afternoon Tea menu is the perfect blend of classic and contemporary. Tuck into dainty finger sandwiches including smoked chicken with tomato and pickled cucumber with dill, before enjoying freshly-baked scones with mascarpone and strawberries. Sweet treats include a tempting iced brownie finger and a delicate lemon madeleine.  Queens of Mayfair is located on Queen St, a five minute walk from Green Park tube or Park Lane bus stops. Situated in one of London’s finest streets, this relaxed yet luxurious setting is the perfect environment in which to enjoy the Great British ritual of Afternoon Tea.
